positions.title: Vice President Software Engineer
positions.description:
Over 4 years as a senior developer, designer, and manager of security and market data systems for BlackRock's premier trading system, Aladdin. Built core servers and processes to load, validate, transform, and support availability for security and mortgage data used by practically all BlackRock applications.

3 years as developer of software infrastructure that supports data interfaces from Aladdin to external client systems.

projects.title: Gymclass (iOS app)
projects.description: I wanted a faster way to sign up for classes at my gym.  So I reverse-engineered their web-based management system and wrote a native iOS app to browse and sign up for classes.  It's free in the App Store.
